chunks: Musa ibn al-Qasim said: Abu al-Husayn al-Nakha'i narrated to me, saying: 'Ubayd ibn al-Harith narrated to me from Hammad al-Minqari, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to me: 'If you wish for your wealth to increase, then frequently stand (in supplication) at As-Safa.'
And whoever cannot prolong standing and supplicating with what we have mentioned, let him do what is easy for him. He narrated.

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah, a title for Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him)
key_terms.الصَّفَا: As-Safa, a specific location in Mecca associated with Hajj rituals and supplication
key_terms.الْوُقُوفَ: Standing, referring to the act of standing in a place for prayer or supplication

ai.seo_question: How can one increase their wealth according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) links the ritual of standing at As-Safa during Hajj or Umrah with the spiritual and material blessing of increased wealth, emphasizing that the efficacy lies in the act of supplication itself. This guidance highlights the flexibility of the practice, allowing for brevity when time is limited, which reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on the accessibility of divine mercy through consistent, even brief, devotion at sacred sites.
